title: parse_cookie returns empty dict when cookie is present
detail: The code returns an empty ImmutableMultiDict immediately when a cookie string is truthy, skipping the parsing loop that follows. This means any valid Cookie header is ignored and an empty dict is returned.
note: Says a present cookie returns an empty dict, which the planted `if cookie:` does.

title: Incorrect file pointer check
detail: The condition now skips processing when fp is not None, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. This causes valid file objects to be ignored and None values to be processed, leading to errors or missing data.
note: Says set file values are skipped and None ones processed, which the planted `is not None` does.

title: Missing ImportError handling
detail: The function now returns a ModuleType unconditionally. If the vendor module cannot be imported, importlib.import_module will raise ImportError, propagating out of callers that expect None. This breaks callers that previously handled a missing module by receiving None.

title: Assumes module import succeeded
detail: After the change to get_module_from_module_name, this code assumes a module object is always returned. If the import failed, the previous ImportError would have been caught, but now it propagates, causing this function to crash instead of returning None.
